excerpt: The KamLAND-Zen (KamLAND Zero-Neutrino Double-Beta Decay) experiment consists of 13 tons of Xe-loaded liquid scintillator (Xe-LS) contained in a 3.08-m-diameter transparent nylon-based inner balloon (IB), suspended at the center of the KamLAND detector by film straps.
title: Limit on Neutrinoless ββ Decay of Xe-136 from the First Phase of KamLAND-Zen and Comparison with the Positive Claim in Ge-76
